svg.title: How I work: five steps on every engagement
svg.desc: 1. Scoping call: goals, access, risks. 2. Written plan before any change. 3. Pull requests your team reviews. 4. Verified in your account: tests, plans, rollback. 5. Handover: runbook and access removed.
svg.text: HOW I WORK · FIVE STEPS, EVERY ENGAGEMENT

g.text: Scoping call: goals, access and risks agreed up front
A written plan before any change is made
Every change arrives as a pull request your team reviews
Verified in your account: tests, plans and a rollback path
Handover: a runbook, and the access you gave me removed
The same five steps on every engagement, whatever the size
